text: 54, the sports and entertainment agency owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), was named lead investor in the Hexagon World Series, a new team padel circuit governed by the International Padel Federation (FIP); SportBusiness reported this as Saudi Arabia's first major investment move into padel.

source.name: SportBusiness (via Wayback Machine) - PIF enters padel as 54 gets new Hexagon event remit
source.quote: 54, the sports and entertainment agency owned by the Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF), was today (Wednesday) named as the lead investor in the Hexagon World Series
